verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is HeyGen's enterprise API page listing "zero data retention options". Data that is never retained cannot later be used for training, so this indirectly serves the story, but it is enterprise-tier only and never mentions AI training. Missing for 10: an explicit documented no-training policy or opt-out control, availability to non-enterprise users, details of how the ZDR option is enabled and what it covers, and independent corroboration.
